scope: User-authorized one-shot old/new choice on 18 previously opened PFF matches; results consume these fixtures for model selection, not a fresh prospective holdout.

hz10_noise0p5.description: 10 Hz requested, 0.5 m xy standard deviation, 2 Poisson burst starts per minute, uniform 2-6 s duration.

hz15_noise0p5.description: 15 Hz requested, 0.5 m xy standard deviation, 2 Poisson burst starts per minute, uniform 2-6 s duration.

hz10_noise2.description: 10 Hz requested, 2 m xy standard deviation, 2 Poisson burst starts per minute, uniform 2-6 s duration.

hz15_noise2.description: 15 Hz requested, 2 m xy standard deviation, 2 Poisson burst starts per minute, uniform 2-6 s duration.

vv_adapter: Apply unchanged PR2 corrupt_geometry to the audited 25Hz canonical PFF geometry, source_hz=25. This is corruption of the model input grid, not a new native-PFF acquisition simulation. Same seed, arrays, valid periods and reference for both models; retain gaps. Do not claim it matches organizer error distribution.

selection.rule: Retain final candidate only if all prespecified comparison guards pass; otherwise roll back to weighted_short_gap. No alternate mixture, decoder tuning or training. Missing/invalid cells block decision rather than being dropped.
selection.guard_scope: Each of 3 cohorts x 6 scenarios x 2 references, separately; never average natural and stress together.
selection.diagnostic_scope: Pooled all18, natural and original blind scenarios, both references. VV diagnostics reported separately; no fabricated target-equivalence assumption.
selection.rationale: Conservative release-regression policy, not a hypothesis-test noninferiority margin. Reuse existing mean/macro/worst guards; add class and gap-error safeguards before any new-candidate audit outcomes. No arbitrary +0.02 improvement requirement. Heavy VV stress is deliberately a conservative veto even if not target calibrated.

uncertainty: Paired whole-match bootstrap, 10000 replicates, seed20261117, descriptive percentile95 interval; shared teams/provider and post-selection reuse prevent a clean generalization guarantee. No frame-level bootstrap.
controls: Freeze weights, inference/scoring source, input hashes, decoder and plan before predictions
Write predictions for all scenarios of a match before accessing its reference
Validate paired inference against both portable entrypoints on training3816, natural and vv_hz10_noise0p5; no quality scores
Regenerate references using unchanged reader and compare exactly with previous audited references
Old natural/blind predictions must exactly match prior recovery audit
No target labels or public-window scoring
No new fitting, calibration, threshold search, result-dependent fixture exclusion
metrica3: Not included in primary gate: previously researched, competition anonymous, not a fresh independent top-level match. No new data acquisition required for this bounded comparison.
